personality_one_liner: A premium, minimal, map-first real estate experience bridging spatial context with high-end editorial clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for premium feel. Never use cramped dashboard layouts. Intentional padding around cards.

do's: Use over map for floating search bars, filters, FABs, and bottom tabs
Sticky action bars on the property details screen over scrolling content
Layer 0 map, Layer 1 glass components to maintain spatial context
dont's: Do not use on regular list rows or input fields
Avoid stacking more than two blur surfaces on one screen

screens.name: Home (Map Discovery)
screens.purpose: Immersive map-first exploration of properties with highly interactive floating controls.

states.loading: Map loading skeleton or spinner with brand tint
states.empty: No properties found in this area map state
states.error: Failed to load map data with a retry button centered on a glass card

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive map behind all UI. Top safe area: Floating glass search bar with embedded filter icon, followed by horizontal scrollable chips for BUY/RENT and property types. Floating Action Button (FAB) for List View toggle. Bottom: Bottom tabs layered over map (use glass) and `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` docked at a peek state for property highlights when a pin is tapped.

screens.name: Property Details
screens.purpose: Comprehensive, progressive disclosure of property details anchored by a high-end imagery hero.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for hero image and text blocks

screens.layout: Hero image gallery at the top with a gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over the bottom 30%. Transparent glass header with back button. Below hero: generous padding (xl), Title, Price, auto-layout utility chips (Beds, Area). Sticky action bar at the absolute bottom holding primary CTAs (Call, WhatsApp, Enquiry) anchored via keyboard/scroll view avoiding logic. Map integration section inline.

screens.name: Post Property
screens.purpose: A streamlined, step-by-step form to list a property, heavily utilizing map pin-drops.

states.error: Form validation errors displayed gracefully below inputs

screens.layout: Clean single-column scrollable form. Floating labels for inputs. A section allowing users to interact with an inline map to drop a pin. Primary submit button sticky at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Favorites & Enquiries
screens.purpose: List views of saved and contacted properties.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty room with a calm message ('No saved properties yet') and CTA to 'Explore Map'
states.error: Failed to load list with retry button

screens.layout: Standard iOS-native clean list view. High-quality thumbnail on the left, price and title on the right. Generous vertical spacing (lg) between list items.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Header with brandTertiary tinted background. Center-aligned user avatar and name. Vertical list of settings rows; each row has a leading Feather icon inside a surfaceSecondary rounded square container.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality but apply the user-requested custom color overrides: Pure white backgrounds (#FFFFFF), Dark Navy typography (#0A192F), and Teal accents (#0D9488). Do not default to Apple blue or Material indigo.

Implement the Home Screen with `react-native-maps`. Ensure the map is the root layer (flex: 1). All controls (Search bar, Filter button, Segmented chips, Bottom Tabs, List view toggle) must float OVER the map using absolute positioning and `expo-blur` glassmorphism to preserve spatial context.
Use `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for the property card interaction on the map. It should dock at a peek height when a pin is tapped and expand fluidly.
Map pins should ideally follow a dual-state pattern: minimal price chips at a wider zoom, expanding into detailed badges on select or zoom-in.
On the Property Details screen, mandate a gradient scrim (transparent to #0A192F) over the bottom of the hero image. Ensure text rendered on top uses `onSurfaceInverse` (#FFFFFF) for WCAG compliance.
Place primary CTAs (Call/WhatsApp) in a sticky glass action bar anchored at the bottom of the Property Details viewport, surviving content scroll.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all typography and cap the weight at 500 max. Use font sizes to establish hierarchy, not bold weights.
For all settings rows or feature lists, place the `Feather` icon inside a `surfaceSecondary` rounded square container (size: 32-40px). Do not leave icons bare.
Implement haptic feedback natively using the events defined in the haptics block (e.g., snapping the bottom sheet or tapping a map pin).
